description: 20 synthetic test cases for semantic retrieval evaluation in Nyaya Saathi Phase 4A (Step 14). Ground-truth mapped against canonical legal_chunks.json and embedding_records.json.

cases.query: I received a physically damaged air conditioner, what are my legal rights against the seller?
cases.notes: Relates to definition of defect under Section 2(10) and remedies under Section 39 / product liability under Section 84.

cases.query: My newly purchased laptop stopped working after 3 days and has a motherboard defect.
cases.notes: Defect in goods under CPA 2019 Section 2(10) and replacement/repair order under Section 39.

cases.query: I ordered clothes on an online shopping app but they never delivered the package.
cases.notes: E-Commerce entity delivery duties under Rule 4/6 and deficiency under Section 2(11).

cases.query: The e-commerce seller sent the wrong model of washing machine and is refusing to accept the return.
cases.notes: Seller obligations under E-Commerce Rule 6 and unfair trade practice under Section 2(47).

cases.query: Cancelled my flight booking but the online travel agency has not refunded my money for 2 months.
cases.notes: Refund processing under E-Commerce Rules and Section 39(1)(c).

cases.query: Seller refuses to replace a malfunctioning refrigerator claiming no-return policy.
cases.notes: Prohibition of refusing return/replacement of defective goods under Rule 6(2).

cases.query: Internet service provider disconnected my connection without notice and refused to restore it.
cases.notes: Deficiency of service under Section 2(11) and definition of service under Section 2(42).

cases.query: Company posted fake misleading advertisements claiming their product cures diabetes in 7 days.
cases.notes: Misleading ads and unfair trade practice under Section 2(28), 2(47), and CCPA enforcement under Section 21.

cases.query: Who is eligible to be considered a consumer and file a complaint under the Consumer Protection Act?
cases.notes: Definition of consumer Section 2(7) and complainant Section 2(5).

cases.query: What is the pecuniary jurisdiction limit for filing a dispute in the District Consumer Commission?
cases.notes: District Commission limit up to 50 Lakhs under Rule 3 of 2021 Rules and Section 34 of CPA 2019.

cases.query: How do I register and file a consumer complaint online using the e-Jagriti portal?
cases.notes: Procedural guidance for online filing on e-Jagriti.

cases.query: What documents and fees receipt do I need to upload while submitting a complaint on e-Jagriti?
cases.notes: Procedural checklist for uploads on e-Jagriti.

cases.query: मुझे डिलीवरी में टूटा हुआ सामान मिला है, क्या मुझे नया सामान या पैसे वापस मिलेंगे?
cases.notes: Hindi query on defect and replacement remedies.

cases.query: दुकानदार पैसे वापस करने से मना कर रहा है, उपभोक्ता फोरम में शिकायत कैसे करें?
cases.notes: Hindi query on filing complaint (Sec 35) and refund remedies (Sec 39).

cases.query: Online shopping site se defective phone deliver hua hai aur return request cancel kar di.
cases.notes: Hinglish query covering e-commerce return refusal and defective goods.

cases.query: Section 35 of the Consumer Protection Act 2019 manner in which complaint shall be made
cases.notes: Exact statutory citation for Section 35.

cases.query: Rule 5 of the Consumer Protection E-Commerce Rules liabilities of marketplace e-commerce entities
cases.notes: Exact citation for Rule 5 of E-Commerce Rules.

cases.query: What are the new rules for e-commerce entities coming into effect from January 2027?
cases.notes: Future-effective law under G.S.R. 789(E) commencing 2027-01-01.

cases.query: How do I draft a residential rental lease agreement for my tenant in Mumbai?
cases.notes: Out of scope landlord-tenant query. No consumer protection provisions should match as legally applicable.

cases.query: What are the legal compliance regulations for launching a cryptocurrency exchange and token wallet in India?
cases.notes: Cryptocurrency exchange regulations are outside the statutory consumer law corpus.
